user.title: Parcel Tracker Setup
user.description:
Enter your Ship24 API key to enable universal parcel tracking across 1500+ carriers.

Get a free key (10 shipments/month) at https://dashboard.ship24.com

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Ship24 API. Please check your API key.
error.dhl_cannot_connect: Cannot connect to DHL API. Please check your API key.

data_description.dhl_api_key: Optional. Provides delivery time windows for DHL parcels. Get a free key at https://developer.dhl.com
data_description.destination_country_code: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3 country code (for example DE). If set, this overrides Home location country.
data_description.destination_post_code: Optional recipient post code/ZIP. If set, this overrides Home location postal code.
data_description.cleanup_days: Number of days after a parcel is delivered before it is automatically removed (1-30)
data_description.scan_interval_hours: How often to poll Ship24 API for status updates (1-12 hours)

error.dhl_cannot_connect: Cannot connect to DHL API. Please check your API key.
error.invalid_country_code: Country code must be 2 or 3 letters (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3), for example DE or DEU.
